productName: Global Power Multi-Currency Savings Insurance Plan 3

trends.whatProductOffers: The policy can be held in up to 9 currency options, and a Currency Exchange Option lets the client change the policy currency from the end of the 2nd policy year, described as the earliest time in the market.

keyFigures.label: Currency Exchange Option
keyFigures.value: Exercisable from the end of the 2nd policy year
keyFigures.condition: earliest in market as of 15 September 2023

exclusionsOrConditions: Exchange is subject to the currencies then available and to the company's rules; the full list is not in the supplied excerpt.
Currency exchange may involve a spread or charge; the excerpt does not state the cost.
Changing currency changes the currency risk; it does not guarantee a better return.
The 'first-in-market' claim is as of 15 September 2023 and may no longer hold.
clientSignalPhrases: wants to hold USD and GBP
negativeSignalPhrases: needs the currency switched in year 1
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the policy can hold up to 9 currencies and switch currency from the end of year 2, which lines up with overseas tuition or a future move.

"Currency Exchange Option exercisable from the end of the 2nd policy year, being the earliest time in the market you can change your policy currency"

Changing the insured does not reset the policy's value or charges but may affect the death benefit calculation.
Settlement option mechanics are not described in the supplied text.

trends.whatProductOffers: A Policy Split Option divides one policy into multiple policies for asset planning, and a first-in-market Bonus Unlock Option reallocates bonuses to pursue potential returns.

keyFigures.label: Policy Split Option
keyFigures.value: Divide the policy into multiple policies

exclusionsOrConditions: Policy split may create minimum policy value requirements per resulting policy; the excerpt does not state them.
The Bonus Unlock Option changes the bonus structure and may reduce the guaranteed element.
Both options are subject to the company's rules and to the policy being in force at the time.

needs separate policies for each child

verificationPrompts: Confirm the minimum value per policy after a split.

Confirm the frequency limits for each option.
sourceEvidence: "Policy Split Option allows you to divide your policy into multiple policies for extra flexibility in asset planning"
"First-in-market Bonus Unlock Option for reallocating bonuses to enjoy potential returns"

The projected break-even year is not guaranteed.
